kind.rationale: One Solana-family instance per cluster (design section 1.2); ledger saga and accounting are reused by copy.

standard.rationale: Recommended for groundwork in the native facts file: Token-2022 mint, 8 decimals, only MetadataPointer and TokenMetadata extensions, freeze authority unset. Classic spl_token is the fallback if a wallet or venue mishandles Token-2022.

signed_payload.value: The full serialized transaction message bytes (not a hash), signed with Ed25519 through sign_with_schnorr; the 32-byte public key is the base58 address.

value.text: The canister's fee-payer address needs SOL for the 5,000 lamport per-signature fee and for associated token account rent (about 0.002 SOL per account, derived).

open_decisions.topic: Solana guard: memo plus durable nonce, or a small program

choice.rationale: Design section 12 (settled for planning): memo plus durable nonce with exact instruction, mint, owner and memo verification and the RC/BU/PR lifecycle; same-attempt reconciliation and archival history availability are mandatory; the missing monotone mint counter (C4) stays explicit; a program guard is a stronger later option, not a research gate.

open_decisions.topic: Testnet escrow: real icUSD ledger or a test ledger

choice.rationale: Design section 12 (settled for planning): synthetic test ledgers for future testnet demos; no real canonical icUSD is locked for a new testnet rollout under this groundwork.

activation_blockers.text: Native token programs give neither consumed-mint nor bridge-out semantics. The first plan is a memo-bound transfer plus a durable nonce (D3, settled for planning), with no on-chain consumed record, so the cumulative-mint check (C4) is unavailable without a program. Same-attempt reconciliation and archival history availability are mandatory; RPC history retention bounds how late a memo lookup works (unmeasured).
DFINITY docs and the sol-rpc-canister README list different canister ids. Confirm which is current before wiring anything.

Returns are held in a canister-owned return account until a finalized burn. No ICP payout happens before the burn is final. The observer must verify the exact allowed transfer instruction, the mint, the owner or authority and the memo association, and never credit a net balance delta alone.
No return observer or memo parser exists. The backend deposit watch polls balances, not burns.
No durable-nonce lane exists for escrow mints. getLatestBlockhash is not supported by the SOL RPC canister, so a durable nonce account per in-flight operation is the alternative.
The canister creates and pays for each holder's associated token account, so its fee-payer address needs SOL for fees and rent.
No Solana wallet connector exists in the frontend. Per-wallet Token-2022 support was not stated on the wallets' doc pages read.
The controller and upgrade-authority model for this instance and its chain-side authorities is not decided (D6). The controller set is the root of trust for escrow and every signature.

value.typical_wait: about 12.8 seconds under TowerBFT; Anza reports Alpenglow live on mainnet-beta, under which confirmed equals finalized

min_quorum.rationale: Baseline of 2 identical results; the SOL RPC canister defaults to 3 providers with multi-provider consensus.

outcall_notes.value: Reads go through the DFINITY SOL RPC canister (multi-provider consensus, default 3 providers drawn from Alchemy, Ankr, Chainstack, dRPC, Helius, PublicNode). getLatestBlockhash is not supported. The listed hosts are the clusters' own public RPC, for reference.
